PermissionSet.label: SCRUM442_Satisfaction_System
PermissionSet.description: SCRUM-442 System-PS: update-FLS for the four system-maintained Account.Satisfaction_* fields (NOT the formula field Satisfaction_Arger__c — formula fields take no write FLS). Needed because the AccountSatisfactionRebuilder writes via Apex DML, and DML checks FLS even in without-sharing classes (ADR-5, house SCRUM436_CaseReminderSystem / SCRUM388_AccountReactivationWrite). Assigned to the Rebuilder's scheduled/automation user only.
